title: MATH GAOKAO - 259
description: Authentic-style mathematics problems inspired by China’s Gaokao — build deeper understanding, sharper thinking, and real exam readiness.

questions.concept: Cross-Section of a Cube by a Plane Parallel to a Face
questions.learningObjective: Determine the area of the cross-section formed when a cube is cut by a plane parallel to one of its faces.
questions.question: A cube has edge length \(4\). It is cut by a plane parallel to one of its faces. Find the area of the cross-section.
questions.explanation:
A plane parallel to a face of a cube cuts the cube in a square congruent to that face. Therefore the cross-section is a square of side length \(4\), so its area is
\[
4^2=16.
\]
questions.hint: Consider what shape is produced when a cube is sliced parallel to one of its faces.

questions.concept: Cross-Section of a Cylinder by a Plane Parallel to the Base
questions.learningObjective: Determine the area of the cross-section formed when a cylinder is cut by a plane parallel to its base.
questions.question: A right circular cylinder has radius \(5\). It is cut by a plane parallel to its base. Find the area of the cross-section.
questions.explanation:
A plane parallel to the base of a cylinder cuts the cylinder in a circle congruent to the base. The radius of the cross-section is \(5\), so its area is
\[
\pi\cdot 5^2=25\pi.
\]
questions.hint: A slice parallel to the base of a cylinder has the same shape as the base.

questions.concept: Great Circle Cross-Section of a Sphere
questions.learningObjective: Determine the area of the cross-section formed when a sphere is cut by a plane through its center.
questions.question: A sphere has radius \(3\). It is cut by a plane passing through its center. Find the area of the cross-section.
questions.explanation:
A plane through the center of a sphere cuts the sphere in a great circle whose radius equals the sphere's radius. Thus the cross-section is a circle of radius \(3\), and its area is
\[
\pi\cdot 3^2=9\pi.
\]
questions.hint: A plane through the center of a sphere produces a circle with the same radius as the sphere.

questions.concept: Cross-Section of a Cone by a Plane Parallel to the Base
questions.learningObjective: Determine the area of the circular cross-section formed when a cone is cut by a plane parallel to its base.
questions.question: A right circular cone has height \(12\) and base radius \(6\). A plane parallel to the base cuts the cone at a distance \(4\) from the apex. Find the area of the cross-section.
questions.explanation:
The smaller cone above the cutting plane is similar to the original cone. Its height is \(4\), while the original height is \(12\), so the similarity ratio is
\[
\frac{4}{12}=\frac{1}{3}.
\]
Therefore the radius of the cross-section is
\[
6\cdot \frac{1}{3}=2.
\]
The area of the circular cross-section is
\[
\pi\cdot 2^2=4\pi.
\]
questions.hint: Use similar triangles to find the radius of the smaller circle at the cutting plane.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the area of the rectangular cross-section formed when a cube is cut by a plane through two opposite parallel edges.
questions.question: In cube \(ABCD-A_1B_1C_1D_1\) with edge length \(1\), a plane passes through the opposite parallel edges \(AB\) and \(D_1C_1\), which do not lie on a common face. Find the area of the cross-section.
questions.explanation:
The cross-section is a rectangle. One side is an edge of the cube, with length \(1\). The other side is a face diagonal of the cube, with length
\[
\sqrt{1^2+1^2}=\sqrt{2}.
\]
Therefore the area of the cross-section is
\[
1\cdot \sqrt{2}=\sqrt{2}.
\]
questions.hint: Identify the rectangle formed by the two opposite edges and a face diagonal of the cube.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the area of the rectangular cross-section formed when a cylinder is cut by a plane containing its axis.
questions.question: A right circular cylinder has radius \(3\) and height \(5\). It is cut by a plane containing its axis. Find the area of the cross-section.
questions.explanation:
A plane containing the axis of a cylinder cuts the cylinder in a rectangle. The width of the rectangle is the diameter of the base:
\[
2r=2\cdot 3=6.
\]
The height of the rectangle is the height of the cylinder, \(5\). Therefore the area is
\[
6\cdot 5=30.
\]
questions.hint: The axial cross-section of a cylinder is a rectangle whose width is the diameter.

questions.concept: Cross-Section of a Square Pyramid by a Plane Parallel to the Base
questions.learningObjective: Determine the area of the square cross-section formed when a square pyramid is cut by a plane parallel to its base.
questions.question: A regular square pyramid has height \(12\) and base side length \(6\). A plane parallel to the base cuts the pyramid at a distance \(6\) from the apex. Find the area of the cross-section.
questions.explanation:
The smaller pyramid above the cutting plane is similar to the original pyramid. The similarity ratio is
\[
\frac{6}{12}=\frac{1}{2}.
\]
Therefore the side length of the square cross-section is
\[
6\cdot \frac{1}{2}=3.
\]
The area of the cross-section is
\[
3^2=9.
\]
questions.hint: Use the similarity ratio of the smaller pyramid to the original pyramid to find the side length of the square cross-section.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the area of the circle formed when a sphere is cut by a plane at a given distance from its center.
questions.question: A sphere has radius \(5\). It is cut by a plane whose distance from the center is \(4\). Find the area of the cross-section.
questions.explanation:
The cross-section is a circle. If its radius is \(r\), then the sphere radius, the plane distance, and \(r\) form a right triangle:
\[
r^2+4^2=5^2.
\]
Thus
\[
r^2=25-16=9,
\]
so \(r=3\). Therefore the area of the cross-section is
\[
\pi\cdot 3^2=9\pi.
\]
questions.hint: Use the right triangle formed by the sphere radius, the plane distance, and the radius of the cross-section.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the area of the equilateral triangular cross-section formed when a cube is cut by a plane through three suitable vertices.
questions.question: A cube has edge length \(2\). A plane passes through three vertices that are pairwise joined by face diagonals, forming an equilateral triangle. Find the area of this triangular cross-section.
questions.explanation:
Each side of the triangular cross-section is a face diagonal of the cube, so each side has length
\[
\sqrt{2^2+2^2}=\sqrt{8}=2\sqrt{2}.
\]
The area of an equilateral triangle with side length \(s\) is
\[
\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}s^2.
\]
Substitute \(s=2\sqrt{2}\):
\[
\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}(2\sqrt{2})^2
=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\cdot 8
=2\sqrt{3}.
\]
questions.hint: Find the side length of the equilateral triangle using a face diagonal, then use the equilateral triangle area formula.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the area of the triangular cross-section formed when a cone is cut by a plane through its axis.
questions.question: A right circular cone has radius \(4\) and height \(6\). It is cut by a plane containing its axis. Find the area of the cross-section.
questions.explanation:
A plane containing the axis of a cone cuts the cone in an isosceles triangle. The base of this triangle is the diameter of the cone's base:
\[
2r=2\cdot 4=8.
\]
The height of the triangle is the height of the cone, \(6\). Therefore the area is
\[
\frac{1}{2}\cdot 8\cdot 6=24.
\]
questions.hint: The axial cross-section of a cone is a triangle whose base is the diameter and whose height is the cone's height.
